data.name: Cascadia Carbon
data.description: Cascadia Carbon is a US/Canadian public benefit corporation founded in 2019, headquartered in Portland, Oregon, with a Canadian subsidiary in Vancouver, BC. It runs the CODEX / Carbonaut program, which uses blockchain and NFTs ("NFTrees") to tokenize individual trees in certified reforestation projects, effectively operating as a crowdsourced carbon offset marketplace rather than directly removing CO2. Activity signals are low and the website footer reads 2023, suggesting the company is operational but quiet.
